title: RailFog Project Configuration
description: Configuration schema for railfog.toml projects defining Functions, Routes, and Capability Permissions

$schema.description: URI pointing to this JSON Schema for IDE validation and autocomplete

name.description: Project identifier. Must start with an alphanumeric character and contain only alphanumeric, underscore, dot, or hyphen characters (PLAT-18).

functions.description: Map of function identifiers to their code entry points, capability permissions, triggers, and resource limits (FN-1, PLAT-6, PLAT-18).

entry.description: Relative path to the TypeScript handler module (e.g. functions/api.ts) within the project root (FN-1, PLAT-6).

permissions.description: Strict capability scopes injected into the function's context (PLAT-6, PLAT-15).

kv.description: Array of KV namespace identifiers accessible via c.kv (KV-2, PLAT-6).

objects.description: Array of Object bucket identifiers accessible via c.objects (OBJ-2, PLAT-6).

queues.description: Array of Queue identifiers accessible via c.queues (Q-2, PLAT-6).

network.description: Outbound network allowlist patterns (host:port or domain). SSRF-blocked IP ranges are strictly prohibited (PLAT-5).

secrets.description: Encrypted secret identifiers accessible via c.env (PLAT-15).

queue.description: Queue identifier this function consumes messages from (FN-2, Q-2).

schedule.description: Standard 5-field cron expression for recurring scheduled invocations (FN-2).

memory_mb.description: Memory ceiling in megabytes (1 to 1024 MB, default: 128 MB) (FN-5).

timeout_ms.description: Wall-clock timeout in milliseconds. Max 30,000ms for HTTP triggers, 900,000ms for background triggers (FN-5).

routes.description: HTTP route declarations mapping URL patterns to function names (PLAT-11). Evaluated by specificity score.

pattern.description: URL pattern matching incoming request paths (e.g. '/api/*', '/users/:id') (PLAT-11).

tier.description: Required consistency tier. Strong tier requires CAS-capable backing provider (KV-5).
